thread:
olivia: quick FYI — noticed the console preflight linter is throwing a confusing error when a route uses conditional grouping + header overrides. repro below, looks like a mismatch between schema 'oneOf' and the editor autofill.

kevin: ugh. can you paste the minimal YAML?

sasha: here — reduced repro. noticed when group has a `when` array and child routes override headers it bails: 
```yaml
- id: group-a
  when:
    - header: x-tenant
      matches: ^acme-.*
  routes:
    - id: r1
      match: /api/v1/*
      headers:
        x-upstream: acme-v1
    - id: r2
      match: /api/v2/*
      headers:
        x-upstream: acme-v2
```

lint-bot: auto-lint: ERROR route-schema: child 'headers' disallowed under grouped route (rule: grouped-child-override). See https://go/redwood/routing-lint#grouped-child-override

devon: hmm I think the linter intended to disallow inline overrides for some legacy group types, but our schema actually allows `routes[].headers` when parent has `when`. Looks like the linter rule is stale.

kevin: is it a schema drift or console UI bug? the editor's preflight shows the error, but the backend accepts the config on save in staging.

olivia: backend acceptance + runtime behavior: runtime merges group-level headers with route-level headers and route-level wins. so save succeeds. but console blocks because lint flags it as 'unsafe'.

devon: two options: 1) update lint rule to mirror runtime+schema semantics (allow child headers, but warn when conflicting with header transform), or 2) tighten schema + runtime to reject ambiguous cases.

kevin: option 1 seems lower risk. we need to add telemetry to detect how many configs rely on child header overrides before making schema-breaking change. can we surface that in the console preflight?

sasha: I can add a quick telemetry probe in the save flow — count configs where parent `when` exists and any child defines `headers` or `headerTransforms`. that's a small query against the config store.

olivia: add to that: capture if child header value conflicts (same header key but different values). we can show a nudge: "child header overrides parent" rather than hard error.

lint-bot: suggestion: relax rule grouped-child-override from ERROR -> WARN. patch: https://go/redwood/changes/relax-grouped-child-override

devon: also update the lint test suite. add unit cases: 
- grouped route with no child headers -> pass
- grouped route with child header override -> warn
- grouped route with child header transform conflict -> error

kevin: let's also add an e2e that saves a grouped config to staging, then hits runtime to confirm merged header behavior (ensure route-level header wins). I'll own the e2e.

olivia: who will update the console UX? we need the preflight panel to display the lint as warning and include actionable link to docs + telemetry count.

sasha: I'll mock the panel. small copy: "Child route overrides parent header — this is allowed. It may change routing behavior; confirm if you meant to override. [Learn more]" with a link to the telemetry details modal.

devon: PR checklist: update lint rule, add unit tests, update schema docs, add telemetry probe, update console message. estimate ~2d.

kevin: filing a tracking task: PLAT-3849. assign to sasha/devon, kevin will do e2e. olivia will QA console text.

olivia: thanks. quick follow-up — do we want a migration lint that scans existing configs and flags likely accidental overrides (e.g., child header value differs only in casing or small typos)? could be noisy.

devon: maybe a heuristic: if header values are semantically identical after normalizing (lowercase trimming) then ignore; if differed by >1 edit distance, flag as potential accidental. that can be a low-frequency background job and surface in the console "config health" dashboard.

kevin: agree. mark as follow-up. for now relax to warn and ship telemetry.

lint-bot: note recorded: rule changed to WARN in staging at 2523456900.

sasha: PR up for console copy + telemetry probe, linking PLAT-3849. PTAL: https://go/redwood/pr/6267

olivia: will review shortly. thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: moving to canary after olivia QA. will monitor telemetry for increased override rates and any unexpected routing errors.

devon: adding unit tests now, ping when CI passes.
